_deal: The mission board's test node (under vanilla's MissionBranch): no conditions, SharesEvent, NumQuestsToRun 1. ELIZA: the beats base is a SLATE quest, so a board Delve needs a board base (posting title + body) before this node can deal it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-12 14:16: "Missonboard quest where a crate was onboard a ship that crashed. Go to the crash site, get the crate which is gaurded by spacers and return it to a POI local to the crashed ship."
_note: THE CRASH SITE CARGO, his design, words Jessica's. Entry: the MISSION BOARD (his "I'm looking for work"),
so the opening voice is the issuer's posting (style guide 33 s4: we, payer on line one, flat, stock closer).
TWO PIECES ARE NOT BUILT, and this recipe is the request:
1. A BOARD posting: written below as board.title / board.body, PROPOSED fields. The beats base is a slate quest.
2. GUARDS on a pickup: spacers placed round the crate when the player first comes near, PROPOSED as the pickup's
guard block (a hostile twin of approach.civilians). The built fallback is a recover beat, but that takes the
item off a body, and his design has a crate you can see.
Crash sites: LocTypeOE_ThemeShipwreckKeyword is on 11 of 491 existing POIs, but that count does NOT bind here.
His, 2026-10-12: "Missionboards spawn the POI, so it is always created". The board places a new wreck, so
the mission always starts; the theme says WHICH kind of POI the board spawns, not which existing one it finds.
The second place is local and leashed (built, as 08a): a POI near the wreck, where the cargo was bound.
Message box on the pickup only, after the fight: a calm moment (his 2026-10-08 rule). Either or: no say there.
Pay: a guarded pickup; suggest med.

message.title: Wreck Cargo Crate
message.text: The crate came through the crash in better shape than the ship did. The seals are scorched, but they held.
